url.description: VictoriaLogs base URL; the sink POSTs to <url>/insert/jsonline

stream_fields.description: _stream_fields query parameter (e.g. host,app): the fields that identify the log stream

time_field.description: _time_field query parameter: the JSON field carrying the event timestamp

msg_field.description: _msg_field query parameter: the JSON field carrying the log message

extra_fields.description: _extra_fields query parameter: comma-separated fields stored as extra fields

gzip.description: true gzips the request body (Content-Encoding: gzip)

max_idle_conns.description: HTTP transport MaxIdleConnsPerHost (connection reuse; one sink goroutine by design)

account_id.description: VictoriaLogs tenant account id; 0 omits the AccountID header

project_id.description: VictoriaLogs tenant project id; 0 omits the ProjectID header

max_line_bytes.description: encoded single-line byte bound; align with VictoriaLogs' -insert.maxLineSizeBytes; 0 disables
